what: Plan leaves SESSION_ID-empty admission state undefined even though rename is skipped
scenario_or_breakage: With an empty SESSION_ID, Step 5c writes the plan but cannot rename the issue to [DESIGNED]; if ADMISSION_READY is left unset or treated like the old SESSION_ID-empty success footer, operators may be told to continue even though /implement title admission will fail
suggested_fix: Set ADMISSION_READY=false and ADMISSION_BLOCK_REASON=session-missing or rename-skipped when SESSION_ID is empty; parse/render it in Step 5d as admission-blocked and add a small test for this edge case.
